title: Concept: Requirement resolves to an untagged commit
description: go.mod declares a requirement pinned to a pseudo-version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a pseudo-version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a requirement pinned to a pseudo-version.
